# Havamind

> AI-powered financial modeling and investor pitch deck generation for startup founders.

Havamind helps founders build investor-ready financial models, run scenario analysis, calculate DCF valuations, and generate pitch decks — without spreadsheet gymnastics or expensive consultants.

## Primary URL

- https://havamind.com/

## What Havamind does

- Builds 5-year financial models from plain-English business descriptions
- Generates investor-ready pitch decks synced with your model
- Compares conservative, base, and optimistic scenarios side by side
- Calculates DCF, revenue multiples, and comparable valuations
- Exports to PDF and Excel

## Who it is for

- Seed and Series A startup founders preparing for fundraising
- Solo founders and technical co-founders without a finance background
- Teams that need investor materials fast without hiring consultants

## Pricing (public landing)

- Starter: free — 1 model, basic AI projections, 3 scenarios, PDF export
- Pro: paid — unlimited models, pitch deck generation, Excel export
- Team: paid — collaboration for co-founding teams
